verification: Discovery only; use vocaloid_features for acceptance evidence.

contract_rows: | `automation.list` | `scope` is `master_volume`, `track_volume`, or `track_pan`; track scopes require `track_index` | Bounds, default and indexed `{tick,value}` points |
| `automation.remove` | `scope` is `master_volume`, `track_volume`, or `track_pan`; track scopes require `track_index`; `event_index` | Current automation list; the zero-tick baseline is protected |

| `automation.set` | `scope` is `master_volume`, `track_volume`, or `track_pan`; track scopes require `track_index`; distinct `points` of `{tick,value}`; optional `replace=false` | Current automation list; replacement retains the zero-tick baseline |
| `controller.list` | `track_index`, `part_index`, native controller `type` | `type`, `points`, min/max/default values |
| `controller.remove` | `track_index`, `part_index`, native controller `type`, `controller_index` | `removed`, old index |

| `controller.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`, native controller `type`, `points` array of `{tick,value}`; optional `replace=false`, `controller_index` to move one selected point with one point and `replace=false` | Updated controller list |
| `controller.types` | `track_index`, `part_index` | `types`: native names and min/max/default values |
| `history.rollback` | None | `rolled_back` and `staged` |
| `history.status` | None | `can_undo`, `can_redo`, `max_undo_count`, `staged` |
| `loop.get` | None | `enabled`, `start_tick`, `end_tick` |
| `loop.set` | `enabled` and/or `start_tick`, `end_tick` | Loop summary |

| `note.add` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `start_tick`, `duration_tick`; optional `number`, `velocity`, `lyric`, `phonemes`, `is_valid_phonemes`, `lang_id`, `expression`, `ai_expression`, `is_protected`, `ai_vibrato_enabled` | Inserted note summary |
| `note.batch_update` | `track_index`, `part_index`, distinct `note_indices`; `transpose` and/or a `lyrics` array | Updated note list; lyrics do not run G2PA |
| `note.clear` | `track_index`, `part_index` | `removed`, remaining `note_count` |
| `note.duplicate` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`, new `start_tick` | Native duplicate summary |
| `note.expression_bounds` | `track_index`, `part_index` | Current native part's minimum, maximum and default dictionaries for `expression` and `ai_expression` |
| `note.join` | `track_index`, `part_index`, distinct `note_indices` containing at least two indices | `notes`: the containing part's post-join note list |
| `note.list` | `track_index`, `part_index` | `notes`: note summaries |
| `note.remove` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index` | `removed`, old `note_index` |
| `note.split` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`, `split_tick` relative to the part and strictly inside the note | `notes`: original and created note summaries |

| `note.update` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`; one or more of `start_tick`, `duration_tick`, `number`, `velocity`, `lyric`, `phonemes`, `is_valid_phonemes`, `lang_id`, `expression`, `ai_expression`, `is_protected`, `ai_vibrato_enabled` | Updated note summary |
| `part.create` | `track_index`, `start_tick`, `duration_tick`; optional `name` (default `Part`) | Created part summary |
| `part.duplicate` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `start_tick`; optional `to_track_index` | Native duplicate summary |
| `part.join` | `track_index`, distinct `part_indices` containing at least two indices | Native joined part summary |
| `part.list` | Optional `track_index`; without it, all MIDI/AI tracks | `parts`: part summaries |
| `part.move` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `start_tick`; optional `to_track_index` (default source) | Moved part summary |
| `part.remove` | `track_index`, `part_index` | `removed`, old indices |
| `part.resize` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `duration_tick`; optional `name` | Resized part summary |
| `part.split` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `split_tick` relative to the part, strictly inside it | `parts`: original and created part summaries |
| `part.update` | `track_index`, `part_index`; `name` and/or `duration_tick` | Updated part summary |
| `performance.get` | `track_index`, `part_index` | Native Robot, Breath, Take, VoiceColor and MIDI-effect bypass state and bounds |

| `performance.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`; one or more of `robot_mode`, `breath_mode`, `breath_type`, `breath_exhalation`, `take_lane`, `voice_colors`, `bypass` | Updated native performance state |
| `phoneme_timing.get` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index` | Current and original phoneme positions and native ranges |
| `phoneme_timing.reset` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`, `phoneme_index` | Reset phoneme positions and ranges |
| `phoneme_timing.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`, `phoneme_index`, `tick` | Updated phoneme positions and ranges |
| `pitch.clear` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`; optional `begin_tick=0`, exclusive `end_tick` (default note duration) | Updated pitch list |
| `pitch.list` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index` | `points`: `{tick, value}` |
| `pitch.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`, `points` array of `{tick,value}`; optional `replace` | Updated pitch list |
| `redo` | None | History status after native redo |

| `selection.get` | `target` is `track`, `part`, `note`, `tempo`, `time_signature`, or `controller`; `part` requires `track_index`, `note` requires `track_index` and `part_index`, and `controller` also requires native `type` | `target`, `selected_indices` |

| `selection.set` | `target` is `track`, `part`, `note`, `tempo`, `time_signature`, or `controller`; `part` requires `track_index`, `note` requires `track_index` and `part_index`, and `controller` also requires native `type`; distinct `indices` may be empty; optional `selected=true`, `clear_existing=true` | Selection after native setters and readback |
| `sequence.get` | None | Title, track count, sample rate, read-only `presend_time_sec`, global tempo settings, current tick |
| `sequence.update` | One or more of `title`, `sample_rate`, `global_bpm`, `global_tempo_enabled` | Sequence summary |
| `tempo.list` | None | `tempos`, `min_bpm`, `max_bpm` |
| `tempo.remove` | `tempo_index` | `removed` |
| `tempo.set` | `bpm`; optional `tempo_index`, `start_tick` | Tempo summary |
| `time.convert` | `from` is `tick`, `bar`, `sample`, or `seconds`; `value` | Seconds, tick, zero-based bar/beat/clock, sample and sample rate |
| `time.delete` | `start_tick`, positive `duration_tick`; optional `include_tempo` (default true) | Applied range, `include_tempo`, `track_count` |
| `time.insert` | `start_tick`, positive `duration_tick`; optional `include_tempo` (default true) | Applied range, `include_tempo`, `track_count` |
| `time_signature.list` | None | `time_signatures` |
| `time_signature.remove` | `time_signature_index` | `removed` |
| `time_signature.set` | `numerator`, `denominator`; optional `time_signature_index`, `bar` | Time-signature summary |
| `track.create` | Optional `type` (`Midi`, `MidiAi`, `Audio`; default `MidiAi`), `name` (default `Track`), insertion `index` (default append) | Created track summary |
| `track.duplicate` | `track_index`; optional insertion `index` (default immediately after source), `name` | Native duplicate summary |
| `track.freeze` | `track_index` | Render a private native track cache; active only for this session, with authoring settings preserved on save/clone |
| `track.freeze_state` | `track_index` | Native `frozen`, `can_freeze`, and whether the cache is owned by this session |
| `track.list` | None | `tracks`: track summaries |
| `track.remove` | `track_index` | `removed`, old `track_index` |
| `track.reorder` | `track_index`, `to_index` in the existing list | Moved track summary |
| `track.unfreeze` | `track_index` | Release a cache owned by this session and restore editable native playback |
| `track.update` | `track_index`; one or more of `name`, native palette `color` (0..15), `mute`, `solo`, `bus_no`, MIDI-only `midi_recording` | Updated track summary |
| `tuning.get` | None | Native `value`, `minimum`, `maximum`, `default_value` |
| `tuning.set` | Finite native `value` | Tuning summary |
| `undo` | None | History status after native undo |
| `vibrato.get` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index` | Type, duration, AI enable state and depth/rate events |

| `vibrato.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `note_index`; one or more of `type`, `duration_tick`, `ai_enabled`, `depth`, `rate` | Updated vibrato state; supplied event arrays replace that event type |
| `voice.get` | `track_index`, `part_index` | Voice summary |

| `voice.set` | `track_index`, `part_index`; MIDI: `voice_bank_id` and/or `secondary_voice_bank_id`; AI: `ai_voice_bank_id` and/or `secondary_ai_voice_bank_id` | Voice summary after native setters and readback |
| `devices` | None | Enumerates native VAE devices and sample rates without selecting a system default. |

| `edit_audio` | `track_index`, `part_index`; optional `position_tick`, `begin_tick`, `end_tick`, `name` | Calls `SetRegion`, `MovePart`, and `SetName`; returns the new native sorted part index. Region tick offsets are relative to the underlying audio asset, not the project start. |
| `effects` | optional `scope=catalog`, `effect_id`, `track_index`, `part_index` | Bundled VEM effect discovery or current master/track/part chain inspection. |

| `export_audio` | `track_index`, `part_index`, `output_name`; optional `overwrite=false`, `original=false` | Copies the current native stored WAV, or original stored asset with `original=true`. This is **whole-asset export**, not region trimming, effects rendering, or resynthesis. |

| `import_audio` | `path`; optional `track_index`, `position_tick=0`, `name=source stem` | Imports a WAV with `WIVSMAudioPart.SetOriginalWaveFile`. Omitting `track_index` creates an Audio track using `InsertTrackEx`; supplying it requires an existing Audio track. Returns the actual sorted part index, region, asset paths, and duration. |
| `inspect_audio` | `path` | Reads actual WAV metadata using the host RIFF inspector; no synthesis claim. |

| `mixdown` | `output_name`; optional `track_indices`, `sample_rate=44100`, `bits_per_sample=24`, `channels=2`, `bypass_effects=false`, `timeout_seconds=120`, `overwrite=false` | Native VAE manual mixdown with VEM effects, file placements, and VSM-rendered vocal parts. |

| `mixdown_stems` | `output_prefix`; optional `track_indices`, `sample_rate=44100`, `bits_per_sample=24`, `channels=2`, `bypass_effects=false`, `timeout_seconds=120`, `overwrite=false` | One native mix per selected track, named `PREFIX-track-INDEX.wav`. Existing destinations are preflighted before the first stem. Earlier completed stems remain if a later native render fails. |

| `process_audio` | `path`, `action` (`reverse`, `normalize`, `time_stretch`, `pitch_shift`, or `voice_change`), `output_name`; optional `overwrite=false`, `ratio=1`, `pitch_cents=0`; `voice_id` required for voice change | Calls the installed WOR offline renderer directly; see action table below. Creates a separate WAV without changing the imported part. |

| `set_effect` | `action` is `add`, `set`, `remove`, or `move`; optional `scope=master`, `slot`, `track_index`, `part_index`, `effect_id`, `parameters`, `preset`, `bypass`, `target_slot` | Edits the native persisted effect chain; no plugin editor is opened. |
| `transport_play` | None | Starts the prepared private native transport. |

| `transport_prepare` | `device_id`; optional `track_indices`, `sample_rate=44100`, `buffer_samples=2048`, `mute_output=false` | Pre-renders native parts and prepares one explicitly selected standalone VAE device for this session. |
| `transport_release` | None | Stops and releases the private device, placements and callbacks. |

| `transport_seek` | `seconds` within prepared duration | Requests a native asynchronous position change; returns `requested_seconds` and `position_update_async=true` separately from current `seconds`. Poll `transport_status` to observe application. |
| `transport_status` | None | Prepared/playing state, device, native position, loop and output peak. |
| `transport_stop` | None | Stops playback, retaining the prepared transport. |
| `dvqm_catalog` | Optional | `is_attack=true`, `voice_id=""`, `offset=0`, `limit=100` (1..256) | Installed native Attack/Release component IDs, numeric IDs, level names, capabilities and total |
| `dvqm_clear` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `is_attack=true` | Cleared native selection readback |
| `dvqm_get` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `is_attack=true` | Native selection, component/level names, speed, top factor and protection |

| `dvqm_set` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `is_attack=true`, `db_id`, `name_id`, optional `speed`, `top_factor`, `is_protected` | Committed native selection readback |
| `languages` | Optional | `{}` | Array of `{language_id,name,default_lyric}` from real native managers |

| `lyrics_apply` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `lyrics`, optional `language_id`, `use_extension_dictionary=false`, `protect` | Mutation result below |
| `lyrics_can_convert` | Optional | `language_id=0, lyrics, is_ai=false, use_extension_dictionary=false` | `{language_id,lyrics,can_convert}` |

| `lyrics_candidates` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `lyrics`, optional `language_id` (default note language), `use_extension_dictionary=false` | `{language_id,lyrics,candidates:[[{lyric,phonemes}]]}` |
| `lyrics_reset` | Required | Target part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`), optional `language_id` | Mutation result below |

| `media_capture` | Required | Target part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`), optional `name`, `tempo` (native hundredths of BPM), `genres=[]`, `types=[]` | `{session_id,clip:Clip,preview_audio_created:false}` |
| `media_delete` | Required | `clip_id` | `{session_id,clip_id,deleted:true}` after native file/catalog removal |
| `media_get` | Optional | `clip_id` | Clip with native part properties |

| `media_import` | Required | `clip_id`, `track_index=0`, `position_tick=0`, optional `name` | MIDI: `{session_id,clip_id,track_index,position_tick,duration,notes}`; audio: `{session_id,clip_id,track_index,imported}` |
| `media_list` | Optional | `query=""`, `genres=[]`, `types=[]` | `{total,clips:[Clip]}` |
| `media_update` | Required | `clip_id`, optional `name`, `tempo`, `add_genres=[]`, `add_types=[]` | `{session_id,clip:Clip}` |
| `note_skill_get` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`) | `duration_tick`, `pre_weight`, `post_weight` |
| `note_skill_reset` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`) | Native default HMM weights |

| `note_skill_set` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`); optional `duration_tick`, `pre_weight`, `post_weight` (weights 0..127) | Committed note-level HMM weights |
| `phoneme_table` | Optional | `language_id=0` | Manual symbol inventory, source pages, and documented Japanese AI restriction; `native_enumeration=false` |
| `phonemes_apply` | Required | Target note (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`, `note_index=0`), `phonemes`, optional `language_id`, `protect` | Mutation result below |
| `phonemes_reset` | Required | Target part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`), optional `language_id` | Mutation result below |
| `singing_skill_catalog` | Optional | `{}` | Installed Singing Skill plugin IDs, names, tags, timing and script availability |
| `singing_skill_get` | Required | Target classic part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`) | Skill, amount, plugin ID, bypass and native bounds |
| `singing_skill_set` | Required | Target classic part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`); optional `plugin_id`, `skill`, `amount`, `bypassed` | Committed Singing Skill readback |

| `style_apply` | Required | Target part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`), `style_id`, `include_audio=true` | `{session_id,style_id,name,midi_effects_applied,audio_effects_applied,audio_effect_count,scope}` |

| `style_capture` | Required | Target part (optional `track_index=0`, `part_index=0`), `name`; optional `sub_genres=[]`, `colors=[]`, `include_audio=true`, `overwrite_style_id` | Native private style snapshot and saved path |
| `style_delete` | Required | Private `style_id` | Native removal, verified file and catalog absence |
| `style_get` | Optional | `style_id` | Style with native effect parameter arrays |
| `style_list` | Optional | `query=""`, `sub_genres=[]`, `colors=[]` | `{total,styles:[Style]}` |
| `style_update` | Required | Private `style_id`; optional `name`, `add_sub_genres=[]`, `add_colors=[]` | Native saved property readback; existing tags preserved |
| `clear` | `clipboard_id`; no session required | Cleared status and whether pasted asset caches remain owned |

| `copy` | Source `session_id`; `kind` (`tracks`, `parts`, or `notes`), distinct `indices`; optional `track_index` for parts/notes and `part_index` for notes (both default 0) | Independent private clipboard ID and native counts |

| `cut` | Source `session_id`; `kind` (`tracks`, `parts`, or `notes`), distinct `indices`; optional `track_index` for parts/notes and `part_index` for notes (both default 0) | Private clipboard ID and counts; selected source entities are removed in native history |
| `list` | No session or options | Active private clipboard summaries |

| `paste` | Target `session_id`, `clipboard_id`; optional `offset_tick=0`; track insertion `index` defaults to append and target `track_index`/`part_index` default to 0 | Native pasted count and clipboard ID |
| `cancel` | none | Close owned input and discard queued events |
| `devices` | none; session ID may be omitted | WinMM input indices, names and capabilities; no input opened |

| `start` | `mode`, `track_index`, `part_index`, `lyric`, `phonemes`, `lang_id`; independent mode also needs `start_tick`; device mode needs `device_id`, `device_name` | Active source, target, event count, origin and synchronization flag |
| `status` | none | Active/source-closed state, target, event count, overflow, callback error, invalid-input and backlog counts |
| `stop` | `end_ms` in synthetic mode; no `end_ms` in device mode | Inserted notes, held notes closed on stop, unmatched note-offs and ignored non-note messages |
| `synthetic_events` | `events` array | Updated synthetic recording status; no hardware used |
